cohort: 393 mother-infant dyads from the CHILD cohort
finding: Milk microbiota composition and diversity at 3-4 months postpartum were associated with maternal factors, breastfeeding practices, and other milk components in a sex-specific manner, with mode of breastfeeding, particularly providing pumped breastmilk, being a key determinant.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with milk microbiota composition and diversity.
